author: Aanszo
body:
Ign : Densetzu 

Reason for ban : macros

Okay, just going to say this right in the beginning  but I didn't think that double clicking was counted as macros (I now do so I stopped). I am also not  the most confident that I will be unbanned again. I didn't autoclick or lag switch but I know that there is a possibility that a couple staff members do think I do. Now, when it as perm banned for Lag Switch, I was recommended by a friend to begin double clicking. He also explained to me that a couple servers allow this since you are still clicking legit. Here in my mind, that made total sense. (I now know that since it is an edge over practically everyone it's 100% cheating so I apologise for that)Anyway, I've gone back to jitter clicking on one side of the mouse and so I far I find it better than before. I click around 14cps and my aim is way better. 
Obviously, some of you reading this will be thinking 'he's lying lol'  or 'eZ deny'  but I ask of you this, please unban. I will go through every single possible edge I have. (tbh just double clicking which I stopped and regedit which just stops me from getting potlag(and I asked amaze if it's fine to use  and he told me better not to use it till further notice so I'll delete it)) 

Bottom line is, I will be using vanilla minecraft with no regedit and I'll only use Razer Synapse for Dpi purposes. Please pm me of you need like an ss or something. I'll gladly do it. I really want to play on avicus :/  Oh, and I took like idk 2 weeks to appeal so I can sort of take some sort of punishment under the advice of amaze(thanks man) so I have a slightly better chance of getting unbanned. Thanks for reading. Anything else you want to ask me pm my Skype. 

-Densetzu
